43: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.
Inside everyone is a frontier waiting to be discovered.
299: As a young and naive recruit in Vietnam, Chris Taylor faces a moral crisis when confronted with the horrors of war and the duality of man.
The first casualty of war is innocence.
555: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.
Anyone can save the galaxy once.
811: When Lenny and his wife, Amanda, adopt a baby, Lenny realizes that his son is a genius and becomes obsessed with finding the boy's biological mother in hopes that she will be brilliant too. Of all human weaknesses, obsession is the most dangerous, and the silliest!
1067: In April of 1945, Germany stands at the brink of defeat with the Russian Army closing in from the east and the Allied Expeditionary Force attacking from the west. April 1945, a nation awaits its... Downfall
1323: A border-town bombing draws Mexican investigator Miguel Vargas into a corruption-ridden police investigation led by crooked captain Hank Quinlan, setting off a deadly struggle over power, justice, and truth.

1835: It's 1961, two years after the original Grease gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors and new members of the coolest cliques on campus, the Pink Ladies and T-Birds. Can he fix up an old motorcycle, don a leather jacket, avoid a rumble with the leader of the T-Birds, and win the heart of Pink Lady Stephanie?
The Music and Feeling go on Forever.
2091: After being shot in a toy store, a serial killer transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. A mother then gifts it to her six-year-old son Andy, which unleashes terror upon the city.
You'll wish it was only make-believe.
2347: A motorcycle stunt rider considers committing a crime in order to provide for his wife and child, an act that puts him on a collision course with a cop-turned-politician.
One moment can change your life.
2603: Demoted Pittsburgh cop Tom Hardy works river patrol while a serial killer targets women from his past, forcing him to conduct an unauthorized investigation to prove his innocence and expose a dirty cop.
They shouldn't have put him in the water, if they didn't want him to make waves.
2859: An aspiring actor in Hollywood meets an enigmatic stranger by the name of Tommy Wiseau, the meeting leads the actor down a path nobody could have predicted; creating the worst movie ever made.
Based on the true story of one movie so bad it became infamous.
3115: Dr. Peyton Westlake is on the verge of realizing a major breakthrough in synthetic skin when his laboratory is destroyed by gangsters. They destroyed everything he had, everything he was. Now, crime has a new enemy and justice has a new face.
3371: In a small English village everyone suddenly falls unconscious. When they awake every woman of child bearing age is pregnant. The resulting children have the same strange blond hair, eyes and a strong connection to each other.
What Demonic Force Lurks Behind Those Eyes?

The battle for eternity is the fantasy of a lifetime.
The Silent Monk / The Monkey King
3883: A married woman realizes how unhappy her marriage really is, and that her life needs to go in a different direction. After a painful divorce, she takes off on a round-the-world journey to "find herself".
4139: Two parents deal with the effects when their son is accused of murdering his girlfriend.
A murder. A suspect. A shadow of a doubt.
4395: Two brothers return to the cult they fled from years ago to discover that the group's beliefs may be more sane than they once thought.
4651: A judge gives con-man Tom Turner a choice—a jail sentence, or a year of honest work. Many people write to God. Somebody is answering.

Science gave him sight. She gave him vision.

As Jack struggles to get used to his new surroundings, Ed helps him regain his confidence on and off the field.
5419: Gabriel is a young, aspiring musical composer whose life seems stuck in the First Act. When his new musical number gets a critical reception, a theatre colleague, Perry, tells Gabriel that he needs to get a life before he can write about one – so he heads straight for his local gay bar.
A story about two guys trying to make it in the big city.
5675: Reunited after 15 years, famous chef Sasha and hometown musician Marcus feel the old sparks of attraction, but struggle to adapt to each other's worlds.
There's Always Been Something Between Them.
5931: A 59-year-old carpenter recovering from a heart attack befriends a single mother and her two kids as they navigate the impersonal, Kafkaesque benefits system. With equal amounts of humour, warmth and despair, the journey is heartfelt and emotional until the end.
My name is Daniel Blake. I am a man, not a dog.
6187: Wang Bianlian is an aging street performer known as the King of Mask for his mastery of Sichuan Change Art in a true story. His wife left him with and infant son over 30 years ago. The son died from illness at age 10. This left Wang a melancholy loner aching for a male descendent to learn his rare and dying art.
6443: A skilled young hockey prospect hoping to attract the attention of professional scouts is pressured to show that he can fight if challenged during his stay in a Canadian minor hockey town. His on-ice activities are complicated by his relationship with the coach's daughter.
The ice... The fire... The fight... To be the best.
6699: After his mother’s death, Zucchini is befriended by a kind police officer, Raymond, who accompanies him to his new foster home filled with other orphans his age. SOMETIMES WE CRY BECAUSE WE'RE HAPPY.
6955: The film centres on Moncho and his coming-of-age experience in Galicia in 1936. Moncho develops a close relationship with his teacher Don Gregorio who introduces the boy to different things in the world. 7211: Rick Rambis and his friends are having the time of their lives on Bull Mountain—until the legendary Papa Muntz' son decides to sell the mountain to a sleazy land developer, have the staff fired and turn Bull Mountain into 'Yuppieville'.
They haven't quite figured it all out, but they're getting a little warmer.
7723: A virtually plotless, gaudy, impressionistic portrait of Rome through the eyes of one of its most famous citizens.
The fall of the Roman Empire 1931-1972.
7979: The Tall Man, that imposing menace from Morningside Mortuary, is back and once again haunting the thoughts of the now-adult Mike and his friend, ex-Ice Cream vendor Reggie. If You Don't Get It This Time, He'll Have To Drill It Into Your Head!
8235: In order to boost circulation of his newspaper, Lord Rawnsley announces an air race and offers £10,000 to the first person who can fly across the English Channel. But one of the participants, Percy, plots to sabotage his competitor's planes. Will Percy triumph?
20th Century-Fox Presents The Motion Picture That Sets Comedy Ahead 100 Years!
8491: Professor James Murray begins work compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the mid 19th century, and receives over 10,000 entries from a patient at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum, Dr. William Minor.
The incredible true story that defined our world.
9003: An unsuccessful over-the-top actress becomes a successful over-the-top authoress in this biography of Jacqueline Susann.
9259: A detective tries to remain loyal to his partner, and his best friend - a mobster.
9515: A couple of young, out-of-work archaeologists in Egypt discover evidence of the burial place of the ancient Egyptian princess Ananka. The tomb of a thousand terrors!
9771: A group of tormented patients stage a coup at an oppressive, dismal asylum after they're not allowed out on an excursion.
10027: On the set of a playwright's new project, a love triangle forms between his wife, her ex-lover, and the call girl-turned-actress cast in the production.
Show biz has always been a little screwball.
10283: The story of The Satanic Temple, a controversial movement that combines religion and activism with the apparent purpose of questioning the basic foundations of US society.
The Devil's work is never done.
10539: Begotten is the creation myth brought to life, the story of no less than the violent death of God and the (re)birth of nature on a barren earth.

Failing in his desperate efforts to find his beloved owner, Hagen joins a canine revolt leading a revolution against their human abusers.
The unwanted will have their day.
11051: In 1970s London, a teenage outsider named Enn falls in love with a rebellious alien girl named Zan, who has come to Earth for a party. Together, they navigate the complexities of intergalactic culture and the trials of first love.
Some girls are out of this world.

No one knows what the future holds. That’s why its potential is infinite.
11563: Paul and Kim meet when their vehicles collide. Paul is fascinated with the attractive Kim. It turns out that the two were childhood friends in Catholic boys' school, but back then, before the operation, Kim was named Karl.
11819: A group of bad cops look to dispose of a body that one of them accidentally shot.
12075: A squad of unsuspecting cops go through a trapdoor to Hell when they stumble upon a Black Mass in an abandoned building.
Enter a world of suffering and madness.
12331: Two former cops start investigating the series of murders that tanked their careers when the killings begin again.
12843: Basque Country, Spain, 1843. A police constable arrives at a small village in Álava to investigate a mysterious blacksmith who lives alone deep in the woods.
13355: The titular adventurer, after defying his parents to go to sea, survives a shipwreck and becomes a castaway on a deserted island for nearly thirty years, learning to build a new life from scratch, discovering companionship with a native man he names Friday, and eventually returning to civilisation a changed man, finding wealth and new challenges.
Every thrill-swept page blazes to life on the screen!
13611: A rat causes a chemical leak at a Papua New Guinea research facility, leading a group of eco-terrorists to demand the closure of all facilities. When a team of Interpol commandos are enlisted to eliminate the terrorists, they find themselves embroiled in a zombie outbreak.
When the Creeping Dead Devour the Living Flesh!
13867: Psychotherapist Ruben Brandt becomes the most wanted criminal in the world when he and four of his patients steal paintings from the world's most renowned museums and art collections.
Membrano Bruno (voice) / Van Gogh's Postman (voice) / Renoir (voice)
14123: A wanna-be concert pianist spends his days making a living by collecting debts for his Mafioso father, a lifestyle that could eventually ruin his dreams of a musical career.
Some will love it. Others will be angered by it. Everyone will be stunned by it!
14379: The ageing wrestler Sultan Ali Khan decides to try his luck on the mat again; to do this, he wants to represent his country at the Olympic Games, but first has to overcome personal issues.
Wrestling is not a sport. Its about fighting what lies within.
14635: A prep-school student accidentally films the drug-related deaths of two classmates, then is asked to put together a memorial video.

15147: The rise of Aretha Franklin’s career from a child singing in her father’s church’s choir to her international superstardom.
15659: A burned-out British police detective finally snaps while interrogating a suspected child molester.
After 20 years, what detective-sergeant Johnson has seen and done is destroying him.

A few years ago in Dunwich a half-witted girl bore illegitimate twins. One of them was almost human!
16171: New York's Odyssey Detective Agency is hired by two different clients to follow two women suspected of infidelity. Ladies' man John Russo trails Angela Niotes, the elegant wife of a wealthy Italian industrialist, while Charles Rutledge and Arthur Brodsky follow Dolores Martin, the beautiful young wife of a jealous husband. Some of them promised they'd never fall in love.
16683: Two San Francisco detectives want to bring down a local hijacking boss. But they'll have to get to him before a hitman does.
Above all... It's a love story.

SH-H-H-H! TONIGHT'S YOUR NIGHT TO HOWL! And howl you will at this funniest of all comedies...
17195: Embarking on a journey to fulfill her dreams as a dancer, a young girl discovers a new style of dance that will prove to be the source of both conflict and self-discovery.
Hear The Music. Feel The Beat.
17451: Wildly optimistic chatterbox Eva Lovelace is a would-be actress trying to crash the New York stage. She attracts the interest of a paternal actor, a philandering producer, and an earnest playwright. Is she destined for stardom, or will she fade like a morning glory after its brief blooming?
A drama fired with Hepburn's blazing genius!
17963: When a good-natured factory supervisor living in Milan with his Northern wife returns to his native Sicily, a decades' old oath forces him to fulfill a nightmarish obligation.

This is the face of a MAFIOSO...sometimes smiling, sometimes savage. Here is the story of a man who returns to his native Sicily for a holiday and finds himself again bound to the silent laws of "The Honored Society."

Enter Robin Hood, acrobatic champion of the oppressed, laboring to set things right through swashbuckling feats and cliffhanging perils!
18475: A famous surgeon is beaten by drunken bullies, loses his memory and cannot recollect who he was before. He gets to a village, lives in a not so well to do family and becomes the Quack - he slowly regains his talent for medicine and saves the lives of several village patients.
18987: Chaos and rampant hormones reign when teenage counselors are left in charge during their summer-camp director's absence.
19499: The Inguri River forms a natural border dividing Georgia from Abkhazia. One of the spring floods has created a little island in the middle of the river, as if made for the cultivation of corn. At least, this is the belief of an old peasant, whose sunburned face resembles the landscape he has trodden for dozens of years.
19755: Athens, the age of economic crisis. Demetris is a highly independent man who lives a normal life. A confirmed bachelor at the age of 33! Demetris tries to change her mind, but Lonesome insists. It’s at this moment that he comes to a decision. This decision will change his entire life. If Demetris goes out, he will meet Christina, the love of his life. If he stays in, he will not meet her. Does true love exist? A love story in a changing world
20523: In this tale of small town intrigue, an urbanite returns to his quiet hometown on an impromptu trip as his Uncle, widely respected in town, struggles to evade suspicion of a murder.
20779: A family intervention goes horrifically awry within the snowy confines of an isolated lake house.
21035: Otherworldly creatures inhabit the bootlegging tunnels underneath a small town mining community, and they kill any of the townsfolk who invade their home.
21291: When a young stage hopeful is found dead, suspicion falls on her mentor, a successful Broadway producer.
Someone will kill this girl tonight!
21803: David Portnoy, a 15-year-old birding fanatic, thinks that he's made the discovery of a lifetime. So, on the eve of his father's remarriage, he escapes on an epic road trip with his best friends to solidify their place in birding history.

Explore the outer limits of imagination where humans battle a race of giant bionoids.
22315: Charles is a bored civil servant struggling through a harsh Utah winter. He spends most of his time reflecting on his romance with Laura, a coworker who left him to return to her husband, an A-Frame salesman.
A romantic comedy for all seasons

23083: Summer 1939. Influential families in Nazi Germany have sent their daughters to a finishing school in an English seaside town to learn the language and be ambassadors for a future looking National Socialist. A teacher there sees what is coming and is trying to raise the alarm. But the authorities believe he is the problem.
Britain 1939. Hitler's grip is tightening. No-one can be trusted.
23339: An artist and her elderly mother confront long-buried secrets when they return to a former family home, now a hotel haunted by its mysterious past.
23595: A puzzling investigation leads a no-nonsense cop down a dark path involving the vicious rivalry between twin sisters and the volatile man they both love.
A truth hidden in every lie.
23851: When strangers Reet and Ruhan cross paths, their journey leads to an abandoned mansion and a dreaded spirit who has been trapped for eighteen years.

Fake film. Real jungle. Real danger. Real idiots!

Refuse to live life by the book.

While the world was falling apart, they were falling in love.

In the wild, only the strong survive

26155: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.
26411: A spark on a Friday can lead to a sizzling weekend fling, but what happens when you get to the inevitable Monday?

27691: Its the summer of 1974. Four friends have planned a recreational weekend hiking and camping in the forest. At a remote truck stop they pick up an anxious hitchhiker who only after a short ride demands they stop the vehicle. She is clearly frightened of somethingbut what she cant begin to describe in her carsick terror. Suddenly the group are ambushed and left unconscious.
27947: A man falls in love with a woman, unbeknownst to the fact that she is a princess in hiding.

He wanted to leave a footprint in history. Instead, he left one in the hearts of people.

As with many shy loner types he has a problem dealing with women so he drugs them and photographs their nude bodies for sexual stimulation. He then murders his helpless victims and so goes the life of a deranged serial killer.
Into the Mind of a Serial Killer
29227: A pleasant road trip takes a nightmarish turn for gemologist Sunny George when he meets with an accident. As his life hangs in the balance on the edge of a cliff in the middle of nowhere, Sunny must not only contend with the great adversity he is in, but the adversaries lurking in the shadows as well.

29739: The film revolves around an engineer working for an oil company in Dubai. He had to return to Egypt after twenty years. He was surprised that the Israeli Embassy was next to his apartment and was trying hard to sell the apartment at first.
29995: An eccentric games inventor dies and leaves behind an inheritance worth hundreds of millions of dollars - which will only be given to the person or team, amongst his family and hired help, who wins a madcap scavenger hunt.
30251: On their first wedding anniversary, Lucky Singh, an entrepreneur from Punjab walks into the lives of Anil Chandra and Bhamini. Little do they know that this man will change their future. Playing along with LGBT support.

They're Free! Ready to Serve You on the Big Screen!

Anjali / Vishakha / Kajal / Hansa / Mallika / Pooja / Rajni / Nandini / Bhavna / Jhankhana / Sanjna / Chandrika
31787: Clover is finishing a veterinary course when her brother dies and she is called home to her family's struggling Somerset farm.
32043: An exorcist priest meets a family that has a daughter who is pursued by a demon.
32299: A small group of Americans travel to Ukraine to film a documentary about the cannibalism epidemic that swept through the country during the famine of 1932. After being lured deep into the Ukrainian forest for an interview with one of the last known survivors, they quickly find themselves trapped in a supernatural hunting ground.
32555: Torn by personal guilt, Italian General Umberto Nobile reminisces about his 1928 failed Arctic expedition aboard the airship Italia.
Forget everything you've ever heard about heroes. Now there is "The Red Tent."

Before the epic battle in the admiral: roaring currents.
33067: "Everlasting" is an award-winning thriller about a High School student who travels from Colorado to L.A. to find the truth behind the murder of his girlfriend.
33323: A terrorist plants several bombs throughout the city of Colombo, Sri Lanka and threatens to detonate them unless prisoners are released.
33579: Ben and Bill are the two worst, completely useless agents - real losers. But who else would you send on a super-difficult top-secret mission? 34091: A down-on-his-luck divorced father struggles to get his life and family back together before it's too late.
When the odds are against you, your best bet is a second chance...
34347: Although new friendships and new love await her, a college freshman discovers that university life is not as simple as she had hoped.

Dr. Charles Marlowe / Mr. Edward Blake

WINGS TO THE WIND...EYES TO THE SKIES!

35883: Three former classmates reunite for their 30-year high school reunion.
36139: Nobita accidentally finds a fossil dinosaur egg mixed with rocks in the dinosaur fossil exhibition site that he had visited before. He returns it to its original state with the 'time blanket'.

37163: Sophie loved Edmund, but he left town when her parents forced her to marry wealthy Octavius. Years later, Edmund returns with his son, William. One night, drunk, William writes Octavius, demanding his daughter's hand; but, being drunk, he asks for the wrong sister.
A Fiery Girl Who Dares The Dangers Of The Sea And A Savage Land... Fighting For The Love Of A Bold Adventurer!
37419: A drunken, self-destructive woman called Betty wanders into a Parisian bar where she meets middle-aged alcoholic Laure. Laure decides to take care of Betty. Recovering in a hotel room, Betty begins to recount to Laure the story of her bourgeois life and her unhappy and unfaithful marriage.
37675: The incredible but true story of how an impersonator was recruited to impersonate General Montgomery to mislead the Germans about his intentions before the North Africa campaign.
The Gigantic Hoax of World War II
37931: The brother and fiancee of a dead policeman infiltrate a female-led biker gang to uncover his murderer.
The cycle-gang gals... scratching... clawing any guy who gets in their way!
38187: Cetarti is drowning in nothingness. They didn't know the road to freedom goes through hell.
38955: A portrait of the lives of a disparate group of patrons and employees at an American watering hole today.
39211: A man falls in love with a woman, a new recruit in his company. He seeks guidance from the `Love Guru' to win her heart, but problems arise when the guru learns that the man is in love with his sister.
39723: An alcoholic American couple travel to Ireland with their son so he can meet his grandmother but they walk in on their crazed uncle who is in the midst of reviving a centuries-old Druid witch.
39979: Five unemployed workers win 100,000 Francs in the national lottery. Instead of sharing the money, they buy a ruin and build an open-air cafe. But difficulties come to split their friendly group apart.
40235: Sean Banan travels to Africa and brings along pop diva Kikki Danielsson, also known as Kikki Dee, to shoot a music video. Something that should be very uncomplicated instead turns into a chaotic road trip.
More fun than you can handle!
40491: In a village in New Mexico, the life of young farm boy Antonio is dramatically changed when an old medicine woman joins his household. This affecting coming-of-age tale recounts Antonio's experiences to reveal the spiritual conflict in his community.
40747: After his mistress is murdered, a Mafia leader goes after the killer with a bloody vengeance. Soon after the hunt begins, a gang war ensues.
Power built an empire. Passion destroyed it.
41003: Keiko surprises everyone when she overcomes adversity to win her first two boxing fights. But when an unexpected incident threatens the closure of her gym, she is pushed further than she thought possible.
41259: Three young guys got work from unlucky gangster... they try to make a great job but everything goes wrong

"Little Caesar" Swaps Dames for Debs...Beer Trucks for Tea Cups!
42283: A tragic comedy centered on the HR manager of Israel's largest industrial bakery, who sets out to save the reputation of his business and prevent the publication of a defamatory article.
42539: A story centered on a company that grants wishes to people looking for a day away from their ordinary lives.
42795: Hoping to overthrow his brother as ruler of the planet Metropolis, the evil Graal enlists the help of the insane Dr. Kraspin, who has invented a chemical capable of turning an ordinary person into a perfect soldier. The people of Metropolis must somehow outwit Graal before he can create an army of these soldiers, or their planet will be destroyed.
43051: The film is inspired by an incredible story of a shepherd dog named Palm who was inadvertently left in the airport by her owner. She befriends nine-year old Nicholas whose mother dies leaving him with a father he barely knows - a pilot who finds the dog at the airport. It's a story of amazing adventures, true friendship and unconditional love.
A True Story Of Unconditional Love
Lyubov Zhurina, head of the flight squad
43307: A self-conscious and self-referential adventure into the (pretend) lives of legendary actors in Paris.

The latter must also juggle his stormy relationship with glamorous circus star Flo Lorraine.
FOR THE MILLIONS WHO CHEERED "THEY DRIVE BY NIGHT"!
43819: Three teenage girls decide to visit a romantic island and find love. They get shipwrecked and end up on different sides of the island. Each girl begins her own romantic adventure either with a man, a boy or even another girl.
44075: Marcin Krysztalowicz's film is both a partisan ballad, showing the real face of German occupation of Poland during WW2 and a startling war thriller. It tells a story of corporal "Wydra", struggling not only with Germans and Polish traitors but also with his own past...
44331: A tough and realistic crime drama unfolds as merciless kidnapper Jerry Barker (Ralph Meeker) demands ransom paid against a young runaway whose fate lands Barker in Casabel Island Prison.
44587: The life of the magnetic Jamaican musician, actress, model and party queen Grace Jones featuring concert performances and intimate, personal footage.
An electrifying journey through the performance, private and public worlds of pop cultural icon Grace Jones
44843: Sumitra travels to Pandharpur to find a ray of hope, after Sangram killed her husband and son and took over their business.

Save the last bullet for yourself.
45611: Arjun an ad filmmaker falls in love with Vaishnavi, a teacher. They decide to get but his mother doesn't approve. When they find out Vaishnavi is pregnant with a baby girl, Arjun's mother forces Vaishnavi to get an abortion. Will they do it?
45867: Raised in foster and group homes, Yazid pursues his lifelong passion for pastry to work with top chefs and become the best.

Ten fingers, ten toes... and gay. Do you still want him?

47403: While interviewing a retired senior lawyer at his house, investigative journalist Praveen Rajashekhar hears a commotion upstairs. Concerned, he rushes to check and is attacked by an intruder. 47915: Wealthy big game hunter (Boone), along with his group, gets trapped in pre-historic times where they are stalked by a ferocious dinosaur.
A lost world!! Ruled by the largest man eating monster of all!!
48171: A member of an Israeli anti-terrorist unit clashes with a group of young radicals.
48683: In their misguided pursuit of happiness outside of marriage, three husbands end up in the crosshairs of a man who is like an elder brother to their wives.
49195: A group of friends in their early twenties re-consider their boring lives in a sleepy fishing village in the Netherlands.
49451: A police detective on the take tries to catch his brother's killer.
Temptation is a thing called money and a red-lipped blonde !
49707: A 24-year-old music enthusiast Noah looks after his baby overnight for the first time.

Vidya informs her dad, Prithviraj, that she has found her dream man, the Bhallas and the Sathes meet and get the couple formally engaged.

In an instant, their world changed forever.

51499: A wrong turn on a jazz singer's road trip results in her car breaking down near an isolated lodge run by a faded starlet and a cocksure, volatile country singer.
He does all the things you like... To forget!

What follows is a journey of discovery, bonding, and unforgettable moments, an emotional ride that comes once in a lifetime.
52011: Alice, engaged to Felix, works as an engineer for a freighter whose other workers are males. On board the freighter, she discovers that its captain is Gael, her first love.
